# rsWall2D · 2D wall

> Module: 2D Architecture / Grids & Walls

[← Back to command index](/en/commands/)

**Function**: 2D wall generated by centerline offset (left and right edges, centerline, end seals, optional hatch hatch), classified into wall group

> Screenshots and videos may show a Chinese-language interface. Labels and control positions can vary by Rhino or RSTool version.

**Run**: Enter `rsWall2D` in the Rhino command line (command-line interaction).

**Workflow**:

1. Command line input rsWall2D
2. Select drawing mode: Line/Arc/Spline/Pick Curve
3. Set wall width, wall type (interior wall/exterior wall/curtain wall), and whether to fill
4. Pick the starting point of the wall (when picking curve mode, select curve conversion directly)
5. Continuously pick the next point to generate a continuous wall, press Enter to end

**Parameters**:

| Display name | Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| wall width | Width | double | 0.2 | >Model tolerance | Default 0.2m |
| Wall type | Style | list | interior wall | Interior wall/exterior wall/curtain wall |  |
| drawing mode | Mode | list | straight line | Line/Arc/Spline/Pick Curve | Pick curve mode can convert existing curves into walls |
| padding | Fill | toggle | false |  | Whether to generate wall hatch hatch |

**Notes**: In the picking curve mode, you can choose to retain the original curve (KeepSource option, only this mode); the other modes are interactive drawing
